source.quote: Aune's own manual for the X8 XVIII, read 2026-11-25; its product page's spec block is three JPEGs. Per-socket, verbatim under « Specifications » and quoted exactly as extracted, spaces lost: « USB:upto32bit/768kDSD512 », « Optical:upto24bit/192kDSD64 », « Coaxial:upto24bit/384kDSD128 », « Lineoutputlevel:2.0Vrms ». A second, DEVICE-LEVEL figure in the same manual's Introduction: « The X8 XVIII DAC uses the FPGA researched and developed by aune, and supports PCM768k DSD512 highresolutionmusicfilesdecoding.Ithasthe special op-amp interchangeable design and seven filter modes. » The filter list, reached by « 2.Pressthebuttonlongertochangefiltermode »: « fastroll-off,linearphasefilter », « slowroll-off,linearphasefilter », « fastroll-off,minimumphasefilter », « slowroll-off,minimumphasefilter », « apodizing,fastroll-off,linearphasefilter », « hybrid,fastroll-off,minimumphasefilter », « brickwallfilter ». Sockets: « Coaxial input », « Optical input », « USB input », « Bluetooth antenna (Bluetooth edition only) ». Neither « native » nor « DoP » appears anywhere in this manual.

facts.chip: None is named. The manual says only that the device « uses the FPGA researched and developed by aune », so no part number and no count exist - and `family` is absent for the same reason. It also mentions a « special op-amp interchangeable design », which is the analogue stage.

device_settings.why: SEVEN filters, all seven NAMED - fast and slow roll-off in both linear and minimum phase, an apodizing one, a hybrid one, and a brickwall. That is the complete ESS-style list and it is published in full, which eleven makers this week have not managed. No OFF or bypass position exists among the seven.

_conditions_une_clause_existe_mais_elle_: Measured 2026-11-25, and the scope decides it. On en.auneaudio.com, where the products and the manuals are, NO terms page exists: the footer carries no legal link and /terms, /privacy, /legal, /about and their /page/ variants all 404. Footer: « (c) 2026 Aune Audio. All rights reserved. » with two Chinese filing numbers. On www.auneaudio.com, the maker's Chinese single-page site, there IS a reuse-forbidding clause - « You may not reproduce, modify, distribute, or otherwise use these contents without our explicit written permission » - but its own preamble scopes it: « Welcome to the Aune Control App [...] This service agreement [...] regarding the use of the App », and the clause's subject is « The App and all its content ». The privacy page is App-scoped too. So this is the Shanling shape inverted - an application agreement instead of a store's - and the product host publishes nothing. Records are written because nothing forbidding covers the pages they cite, and the App clause is recorded here so a reader can take the stricter view if they disagree.
_tous_les_blocs_de_specifications_des_pa: Checked on the S18 EVO, S9c Pro, Yuki, Yuki SE, X1s GT, X5s 8th, S10N/S10 Pro, ARU1 and X8 XVIII: each page's `specs_html` field contains nothing but img tags. No number was read off any of them; every figure here comes from the text of the maker's own manual PDF, linked from en.auneaudio.com/downloads.
_les_PDF_dAune_perdent_leurs_espaces_ent: An extraction fact that changes how these quotes look. Aune's PDFs lose most inter-word spaces in extraction - « UserManual », « upto32bit/768k » - and they are quoted EXACTLY as extracted, with no space put back by hand. Sanity checks passed on « Specifications », « Bluetooth » and « filter ». In the S18 EVO manual the ffi ligature is dropped, « aune's o cial website » where the document reads official, and that too is left as extracted. Third distinct extraction failure met today, after pdftotext -layout eating every « t » in Shanling's manuals and a Type-1C font with no Unicode map making VMV's English tables unreadable.
_le_mot_NOS_napparait_sur_aucune_page_ni: So the non-oversampling against New-Old-Stock ambiguity never arose for this maker, and no Aune model in the current range is described as having a valve output stage. No model claims an oversampling-bypass or a filter-OFF position either: every filter menu here is a choice among filters, never a way to leave them out. `correctable` is written on no Aune record.
_TROIS_prises_TROIS_plafonds_et_le_coaxi: « USB:upto32bit/768kDSD512 », « Coaxial:upto24bit/384kDSD128 », « Optical:upto24bit/192kDSD64 ». Three sockets, three different ceilings, each with its own DSD figure - and the coaxial takes twice the rate and twice the DSD of the optical, which most makers rate together. The cleanest three-tier per-input table in the base after the Electrocompaniet ECD 2 and the MUSICIAN range, and the device figure of « PCM768k DSD512 » in the Introduction is the USB figure restated without its socket.
_le_convertisseur_est_un_FPGA_maison_et_: « uses the FPGA researched and developed by aune ». No part number exists because the converter is not a part: the maker programmed it. `chip` carries the sentence and `family` is absent - the chip-families vocabulary has no entry for a maker's own FPGA, and inventing one from a single sentence would be worse than the gap. Rockna and Chord sit in the same position in this base, and the MUSICIAN range too.
